author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Filipinos don't believe in language purity, as they mix languages, typically Tagalog and English, freely, this code-switching being called Taglish. Tagalog proper is already full of Spanish loanwords and borrowings from other languages, like Hokkien. The Philippines is under the American sphere of influence, and code-switching is how Filipinos deal with modernization. Tagalog has an "old attic" of vintage words, with which modern Filipinos are less familiar, but which are still in common use in rural areas and with old folk.

text: 菲律賓人唔相信語言嘅純潔，因為佢哋可以自由噉混合語言，通常係塔加洛文同英文，呢種編碼轉換叫做塔格洛式英文。塔加洛文本身已經充滿咗西班牙文嘅借詞同其他語言嘅借用詞，例如福建話，菲律賓喺美國嘅影響範圍之下，而密碼轉換就係菲律賓人點樣處理現代化，而呢啲字係現代菲律賓人唔太熟悉嘅。塔加洛文有一個「舊頂樓」，入面有啲古董字，現代菲律賓人對呢啲字唔太熟悉，但係喺鄉下同老人家仍然常用啲。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the past, insurance companies could take advantage of you. They could deny coverage to children who had asthma or were born with a heart defect, put a lifetime cap on the amount of care they would pay for, or cancel your coverage when you got sick just by finding an accidental mistake in your paperwork. The Affordable Care Act creates a new Patient’s Bill of Rights that protects you from these and other abusive practices.

text: 以前保險公司可以利用你。佢哋可以拒絕對有哮喘或者天生有心臟缺陷嘅小朋友提供保障，將佢哋會支付嘅護理金額設為終身上限，或者喺你病咗嗰陣，只係喺你嘅文件入面發現一個意外錯誤就取消你嘅保障。 《負擔得起嘅醫療法案》制定咗一個新嘅病人權利法案，保護你免受呢啲同其他虐待行為嘅影響。
